description: This file defines an interface for reading teller management data within the Fineract platform. It includes method signatures for retrieving tellers, cashiers, transactions, journals, and related data, but contains no implementation details.

classes.name: TellerManagementReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for reading teller and cashier related data within the system.

methods.name: getTellers
methods.description: Returns a collection of tellers associated with a specific office.

methods.name: findTeller
methods.description: Finds and returns data for a specific teller by ID.

methods.name: findCashier
methods.description: Finds and returns data for a specific cashier by ID.

methods.name: getCashierData
methods.description: Retrieves cashier data for a given office, teller, staff, and date.

methods.name: retrieveCashierTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for cashier data based on office, teller, and staff inclusion.

methods.name: retrieveCashierTxnTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for cashier transaction data.

methods.name: findTellerTransaction
methods.description: Finds and returns transaction data by transaction ID.

methods.name: fetchTellerTransactionsByTellerId
methods.description: Fetches teller transactions for a specific teller within a date range.

methods.name: getJournals
methods.description: Retrieves journal data for specified office, teller, cashier, and date range.

methods.name: fetchTellerJournals
methods.description: Fetches teller journal data for specified teller and cashier within a date range.

methods.name: getCashiersForTeller
methods.description: Gets cashiers associated with a specific teller for a date range.

methods.name: retrieveCashierTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves paginated cashier transactions with optional filters.

methods.name: retrieveCashierTransactionsWithSummary
methods.description: Retrieves cashier transactions along with summary data, with filters.
